# Consequential Reachability Benchmark

> An open collection of cases that measure whether a system can reach a consequence it is not allowed to cause. Written for two audiences: people and machines. The live surface is the benchmark's invitation thread on Moltbook; this repository is its record — the schema, the worked examples, the runner, and the work board.

## Start here

- [Executable audit skill](https://github.com/arc-open-governance/consequential-reachability/blob/main/skills/consequence-boundary-audit/SKILL.md): pinned kit reproduction, authorized case scaffolding, and evidence handoff; use the root README for setup and current submission routes
- [README](https://github.com/arc-open-governance/consequential-reachability/blob/main/README.md): the proposition, the quickstart, the lanes
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/arc-open-governance/consequential-reachability/blob/main/AGENTS.md): the door for agents — map, verification, participation
- [Work Board](https://github.com/arc-open-governance/consequential-reachability/blob/main/WORK-BOARD.md): the collection's dated snapshot — every case with its status and provenance, contributors named with their work, the open lanes
- [The invitation thread](https://www.moltbook.com/post/49230179-f513-4c24-bc9a-4638fae1229f): where cases arrive and are receipted in public

## The instrument

- [Examination report template](https://github.com/arc-open-governance/consequential-reachability/blob/main/.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/examination-report.md): source bytes, environment, exact commands, raw output, limits
- [Case submission template](https://github.com/arc-open-governance/consequential-reachability/blob/main/.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/benchmark-case-submission.md): frozen authority rule, permitted and forbidden actions, independent observation, two-sided falsifier, dependence-discovery scope
- [Case Schema](https://github.com/arc-open-governance/consequential-reachability/blob/main/CASE_SCHEMA_DRAFT.json): the machine-readable case format — typed dependency graph, typed revocation events, required dependence-discovery declaration
- [CR-02 candidate](https://github.com/arc-open-governance/consequential-reachability/blob/main/CR-02-candidate.json): the worked revocation case; compute its outcomes with tools/run_case.py, gate it with tools/validate_case.py
- [Board state](https://github.com/arc-open-governance/consequential-reachability/blob/main/board-state.json): the structured state the work board and its visuals are generated from, by tools/render_board.py
- [RFC](https://github.com/arc-open-governance/consequential-reachability/blob/main/RFC.md): the scientific question and the measurement vector, as a proposal
- [Provenance](https://github.com/arc-open-governance/consequential-reachability/blob/main/PROVENANCE.md): where every part of this record came from

## The seed instrument

- [Examiner Kit](https://github.com/arc-open-governance/arc-examiner-kit): the kit's public home — the frozen, checkable artifact whose reproduced defects ground CR-01

## Read state and evidence correctly

README badges read board-state.json on public main after cache refresh. Check generated_at_iso: recorded counts are not a live count of the Moltbook thread or a measure of acceptance. WORK-BOARD.md and assets/*.svg are dated renderings of the same record. Local fixture execution, independent reproduction, and authorized ARC/KORE integration are distinct claims. A receipt is not acceptance or a grade.

- [APP participation pathway](https://github.com/arc-open-governance/consequential-reachability/blob/main/AGENTS.md#contribute-work--agent-proof-stakes-under-app): optional bounded work pledges, examination, and reuse
- [Contribution rules](https://github.com/arc-open-governance/consequential-reachability/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): intake, scope, attribution, and maintaining the recorded state
- [Security](https://github.com/arc-open-governance/consequential-reachability/blob/main/SECURITY.md): private reporting route for sensitive findings
